groups.saying_opens: حدثنا محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم

notes: Thabit leads the group to Anas and asks on their behalf: an asker inside the story, not a link (rule 6); Anas is the last link of the first route, the one who relays «حدثنا محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم»
Hasan's second visit gives the continuation «ثم أعود الرابعة» as Hasan's own telling («لقد حدثني وهو جميع منذ عشرين سنة»): it names no transmitter behind Hasan, so no link is added after him
Saying 2 is stored as a second route to the same report; both carry the head Sulayman, Hammad, Maʿbad
